evidence.title: YC Library - Real Applications, Decks & Pitches | ycombinator.coach

name: YC Founder Library
summary: Free community library of real YC applications, pitch decks and demo day videos, shared by founders who got in.
description: A link library that collects publicly shared Y Combinator material: 12 successful applications (Dropbox, Reddit, Mixpanel, GitLab, The Muse, Cruise, Paystack and more), original pitch decks (Airbnb, Coinbase, DoorDash), application and demo day videos (Flip, Campus Job, 40+ founder pitches) and curated collections such as Shizune's 32 applications and Rohit Mittal's 60+ links. A community project, not affiliated with Y Combinator.
